text_block_list.text:
"—Over the course of these nearly three 
years, Smart Falcon has secured 
undeniable, overwhelming popularity."

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: F-A-L-C-O-N, Falco-! F-A-L-C-O-N!

Standing at the forefront of the racing 
world, bringing excitement day after 
day—amidst all of that...
Excuse meee! Got a second?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: !? H-Haiseiko-san!? Why are you here!?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry for dropping by out of the 
blue. Actually, there's something I'd like 
to consult you about.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I'm planning a huge live 
show... and I'd really love to share the 
stage with a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I'll definitely go see it! Who are 
you co-starring with?!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Fufufu. Now, guess who?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Well, you see~. ...It's Falco-chan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Eeeeeek!?!?

text_block_list.name: Shocked Fans
text_block_list.text:
...Ehh!? Haiseiko-chan and Falco-chan are 
doing a live together!? Man, I've gotta 
take off work to see this live in person!

"As soon as it was announced, it 
completely dominated trends on Umatwitt. 
Amidst massive excitement in the 
community, the day of the concert 
arrived."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: ...I'm looking forward to it, Falco-chan.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course! To be on stage with 
Haiseiko-san, whom I've admired for so 
long...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're exaggerating~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I-It's not an exaggeration! Your 
achievements on the track, your charisma 
as an Umadol, and how you've stayed 
everyone's beloved Umadol all this 
time—all of it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Now, even I can understand just a 
little. Just how much effort went on 
behind the scenes."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Sure, whether back when I was a 
rookie or after I started racing, a lot 
happened, but...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Effort is to polish yourself. Defeat is a 
spring to leap even higher. Everyone's 
cheers are a gathering, glittering light.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Every single bit of it was a brilliant 
time for me. I never once thought I was 
pushing myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's amazing...! I really think 
that way of thinking is so incredible.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it's not that amazing. After all...—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Falco-chan. You really are just like me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
You know, I love both idols and racing. So 
whenever there's a girl who's sparkling, I 
just can't help but pay attention to her.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if you noticed. Pretty much from 
the start, I was secretly going to your 
concerts and checking your races.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Even when she stumbled from time to 
time, she never once showed any signs of 
pain."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
No matter the time, she believed in her 
own individuality and showered the world 
with her sparkling radiance.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm happy. To be able to stand on the 
same stage with a girl like that."

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oops, my bad, my bad. It's about that 
time, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Let's show everyone our very best 
"Haiseiko" and "Smart Falcon"!♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan
text_block_list.text: "Falcooo! F-A-L-C-O-N!"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko Fan
text_block_list.text: HA-I-SE-I-KO!! Monster-chaaaan!!!!

—Standing on stage alongside Haiseiko, 
Smart Falcon shone just as brightly as the 
legend next to her.

It truly made one feel that she had become 
a new legend.
